links.outcome: Stability of top-20 feature importance rankings after removing the top-ranked feature
links.effect: Supervised models had unstable feature rankings even under minimal perturbation (<0.1% feature removal). Highly Variable Gene Selection and Spearman correlation gave stable feature sets with competitive predictive performance.
links.quote: Supervised models exhibited unstable feature importance rankings even under minimal perturbations (<0.1% feature removal), suggesting that high predictive accuracy may obscure fragile or misleading explanations.

unlisted_practices: Using feature ranking order consistency as a stability metric when evaluating model explanations

screen.reason: The study empirically tests an evaluation/validation safeguard practice (feature ranking order consistency under perturbation) for precision oncology predictive models, showing that accuracy alone is insufficient for reliable explanations.

primary.practice: feature importance stability evaluation under perturbation
